Lexar NQ100 240GB 2.5-Inch SATA III (6Gb/s) Internal Solid State Drive (SSD)

Revitalize your legacy laptop or desktop PC and enjoy faster boot-ups with the dependable Lexar NQ100 240GB 2.5-Inch SATA III SSD. Available at Turbo Computer, this cost-effective storage hardware upgrade replaces slow mechanical hard drives to deliver impressive sequential read speeds up to 550MB/s. It stands as the definitive choice for users across Egypt looking for an easy, budget-friendly hardware modification to speed up system configurations and improve daily workflow tracking.

The Lexar NQ100 features a standard 7mm slim 2.5" form factor, ensuring wide compatibility with older notebooks and desktop drive bays. Engineered with no moving parts, it provides silent operation, improved thermal cooling, and advanced shock and vibration resistance to keep your critical data highly secure. With its refreshed bandwidth tracking efficiency and low-power management, it offers an enhanced and stress-free everyday desktop ecosystem.
